changes.detail: Normalized source to canonical DVS URL without trailing slash (https://www.dvs.virginia.gov/employment-transition/virginia-values-veterans-v3-program) as returned by official search; content unchanged (free employer training/certification, $0 cost).

4 programs re-verified unchanged: Real Property Tax Exemption (Va. Const. Art. X Sec. 6-A; Code of Va. 58.1 Ch. 32 Art. 2.3, applied via local Commissioner of the Revenue), VMSDEP (tuition/fee waiver, 8 semesters, 90%+ or P&T sponsor), DWR disabled veteran lifetime licenses (30%+ rating; free for P&T), and VVFS (DVS care coordination, peer support, TBI/PTSD). Verified via dvs.virginia.gov and dwr.virginia.gov search results.

Prior blurb said institutions are required to waive tuition for veterans. Per RCW 28B.15.621 (app.leg.wa.gov), the waiver is mandatory ('shall', subsec. 4) only for children and spouses/domestic partners of veterans/Guard members who died, became totally disabled, or are POW/MIA; for veterans themselves it is permissive ('may', subsec. 2-3). Blurb rewritten accordingly; DVA source URL kept.

changes.program: Free or Reduced Rate Passes (State Parks Disabled Veteran Lifetime Pass)
changes.detail: Renamed to the official program name 'Lifetime Disabled Veteran Pass', clarified residency requirement and that no Discover Pass is needed, and repointed source to the Washington State Parks program page (https://parks.wa.gov/passes-permits/get-park-pass/lifetime-disabled-veteran-pass).

3 programs re-verified unchanged: Disabled Veteran Property Tax Exemption (80%+ or paid at 100% rate, income-tiered, via county assessor; dva.wa.gov), Washington State Veterans Homes (Orting, Port Orchard, Spokane, Walla Walla; Medicare/Medicaid certified), and WDFW reduced-fee licenses (30%+ service-connected; wdfw.wa.gov).

Removed unsupported 'and certain spouses' wording; eligibility per WVDVA Education Benefits page is dependents aged 16-25 of WV-resident service members who died as a result of wartime service; tuition/fee waiver plus WVDVA living-expense award (https://veterans.wv.gov/benefits/Pages/Education-Benefits.aspx).

changes.program: Free Hunting, Fishing, and Trapping Licenses for Disabled Veterans
changes.detail: Added VA auto-grant recipients to eligibility and repointed source to the WVDVA State Benefits page (https://veterans.wv.gov/benefits/Pages/StateBenefits.aspx), which was fetched and confirms the benefit; the prior wvdnr.gov/programs-publications/disability-services/ URL did not surface in official search results this pass.
Added verified WVDVA facility page URLs for the Clarksburg Veterans Nursing Facility and Barboursville Veterans Home, which the prior pass had left unverified.

3 programs re-verified unchanged: Homestead Exemption for 100% P&T disabled veterans (W.Va. Code 11-6B, confirmed on WVDVA State Benefits page), Disabled Veteran Real Property Tax Credit (refundable, 90-100% rating, effective Jan 1 2024, Form DV-1; tax.wv.gov), and Veterans Re-education Assistance Program (WVDVA per-semester stipend).

Clarified the cap is 128 credits or 8 semesters whichever is longer, that it covers graduate programs, and that unremarried surviving spouses qualify, per dva.wi.gov/benefits/education/wi-gi-bill/ search result. No substantive weakening.

changes.program: Veterans Hunting and Fishing License Benefits
changes.detail: Made the disabled-veteran piece specific: 50%+ resident veterans qualify for the DNR Disabled Veteran Recreation Card (fishing, small game, state park/trail admission); one-time free license is for war-period veterans within 365 days of discharge (dva.wi.gov hunting-fishing-license page; dnr.wisconsin.gov/permits/veterans.html).

WDVA press release says the Chippewa Falls and Green Bay VHRP sites closed by September 30; only Union Grove remains. Blurb updated and note added (https://dva.wi.gov/press/two-veteran-housing-and-recovery-program-sites-to-close/).

2 programs re-verified unchanged: Veterans and Surviving Spouses Property Tax Credit (refundable, 100% or IU, principal residence + up to one acre) and Wisconsin Veterans Homes (Chippewa Falls, King, Union Grove; 24-hour skilled nursing for veterans, spouses, Gold Star parents).

Blurb now states who qualifies (honorably discharged wartime or overseas campaign/expeditionary-medal veterans, certain disabled veterans, unremarried surviving spouses, 3-year residency), per Wyoming Department of Revenue Tax Relief page (https://wyo-prop-div.wyo.gov/tax-relief). Dollar amount still left out.

Renamed to the program name used on the State Approving Agency site, 'Overseas Combat Veteran (OCV) Tuition Benefit', and added the eight-semester cap from the statute text. veteranseducation.wyo.gov was fetched: it lists the OCV benefit but links out for details. Source kept.

Renamed to match the current statute heading (W.S. 19-14-102, 'Interview Preference in Public Departments'). Clarified that it covers all public departments, requires 1-year residency, and gives 10% to veterans with a 10% or higher service-connected rating. Statute text confirmed through search results.

changes.program: Veterans' Interview Preference in Public Employment (W.S. 19-14-102)
changes.detail: The existing source URL (dws.wyo.gov veteran-employment-services) was fetched. It covers Workforce Center priority of service, not the hiring preference, so it does not support this program. No official wyo.gov page describing the preference came up in search (only uwyo.edu HR and law.justia.com statute text). The URL is kept for now and should be replaced with the wyoleg.gov statute or a State HR Division page in a follow-up.
Added 117-bed capacity and the connected assisted-living and skilled-nursing communities, per health.wyo.gov/aging/veteranshome pages. Source kept.

changes.program: Free Game and Fish Licenses for Disabled Veterans and Purple Heart Recipients
changes.detail: Added the free 100% Disabled Veteran Bird, Fish and Small Game License, and noted the 50% fishing license is lifetime, per WGFD license documents (wgfd.wyo.gov). Source kept.

0 programs unchanged verbatim. All 5 still exist and were refined above. Agency (Wyoming Veterans Commission, wyomilitary.wyo.gov) confirmed. The notes on no state income tax and the Oregon Trail State Veterans Cemetery still hold.

programs.name: Real Property Tax Exemption for 100% Disabled Veterans
programs.blurb: Exempts the principal residence (and up to one acre) of veterans with a 100% permanent and total service-connected disability, plus a local property tax exemption for one vehicle, with surviving-spouse continuation.

programs.name: Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program (VMSDEP)
programs.blurb: Provides education benefits at Virginia public colleges and universities to spouses and children of military members killed, missing in action, taken prisoner, or at least 90% permanently disabled from service.

programs.name: Virginia Values Veterans (V3) Program
programs.blurb: Free state training and certification program that helps employers recruit, hire, and retain veterans, and connects veteran job seekers with V3-certified employers.

programs.name: Disabled Veterans' Lifetime Hunting and Fishing Licenses
programs.blurb: Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources offers free and reduced-fee lifetime hunting, freshwater fishing, and trapping licenses to resident veterans with a service-connected disability rating of 30% or greater.

programs.name: Virginia Veteran & Family Support (VVFS)
programs.blurb: Statewide program providing care coordination, peer support, and community resource connections for veterans and families addressing transition challenges, PTSD, and traumatic brain injury.

agency.name: Washington State Department of Veterans Affairs (WDVA)

programs.name: Disabled Veteran Property Tax Exemption
programs.blurb: Reduces the assessed value of a primary residence for veterans with at least an 80% service-connected disability rating (or paid at the 100% rate), on a tiered schedule with county income requirements.

programs.name: Washington Tuition Waiver
programs.blurb: Requires state community colleges, colleges, and universities to waive all undergraduate tuition and fees (with a textbook stipend) for children and spouses or domestic partners of eligible veterans and National Guard members who died or became totally disabled from service or are POW/MIA, and lets institutions waive all or part of tuition for eligible veterans themselves (RCW 28B.15.621).

programs.name: Washington State Veterans Homes
programs.blurb: WDVA operates four Medicare/Medicaid-certified long-term care homes - Orting, Port Orchard, Spokane, and Walla Walla - serving veterans, spouses, surviving spouses, and Gold Star parents.

programs.name: Reduced-Fee Hunting and Fishing Licenses for Disabled Veterans
programs.blurb: Washington Department of Fish & Wildlife offers half-price hunting and fishing licenses to veterans with a service-connected disability rating of 30% or more.

programs.name: Lifetime Disabled Veteran Pass (Washington State Parks)
programs.blurb: Washington resident veterans with a 30% or greater combined service-connected disability can get a free lifetime pass for free day-use parking (no Discover Pass needed), camping or moorage, boat launch, and trailer dump at state parks.

states.name: West Virginia

agency.name: West Virginia Department of Veterans Assistance

programs.name: Homestead Exemption for 100% Disabled Veterans
programs.blurb: Exempts a portion of the assessed value of the primary residence from property taxes for veterans with a 100% permanent and total service-connected disability.

programs.name: Disabled Veteran Real Property Tax Credit
programs.blurb: Refundable state income tax credit (effective 2024) for real property taxes paid on the homestead of honorably discharged veterans with a 90-100% combined VA disability rating.

programs.name: War Orphan Education Program
programs.blurb: Waives tuition and fees at West Virginia post-secondary schools, plus a WVDVA living-expense award, for dependents aged 16 to 25 of service members who were West Virginia residents at enlistment and died as a result of wartime military service.

programs.name: Veterans Re-education Assistance Program
programs.blurb: State stipend per semester for eligible veterans enrolled in certified post-secondary education or vocational training in West Virginia.

programs.name: Free Hunting, Fishing, and Trapping Licenses for Disabled Veterans
programs.blurb: Resident veterans rated 100% permanent and total service-connected disabled by the VA, those receiving VA auto grant benefits, and former POWs may hunt, trap, and fish without purchasing a license (W.Va. Code 20-2-28).

states.notes: Military retirement income is fully exempt from WV personal income tax for tax years 2019 and later (see https://tax.wv.gov/Documents/TSD/tsd443.pdf; not re-fetched this pass). WVDVA operates the West Virginia Veterans Nursing Facility in Clarksburg (https://veterans.wv.gov/facilities/Pages/clarksburgnursing.aspx) and the West Virginia Veterans Home in Barboursville (https://veterans.wv.gov/facilities/Pages/veteranshome.aspx). WV State Parks also offer a 'Veterans' Salute' lodging/camping discount listed on the WVDVA State Benefits page.

states.name: Wisconsin

programs.name: Veterans and Surviving Spouses Property Tax Credit
programs.blurb: Refundable state income tax credit equal to the property taxes paid on the principal residence (up to one acre) of veterans with a 100% service-connected disability rating or individual unemployability, and their unremarried surviving spouses.

programs.name: Wisconsin GI Bill
programs.blurb: Full tuition and segregated fee remission for eligible veterans and qualifying spouses, surviving spouses, and children for 128 credits or eight semesters (whichever is longer) at University of Wisconsin System and Wisconsin Technical College System schools, including graduate programs.

programs.name: Wisconsin Veterans Homes
programs.blurb: State-run homes at Chippewa Falls, King, and Union Grove providing 24-hour skilled nursing care to veterans, spouses, and Gold Star parents.

programs.name: Veterans Hunting and Fishing License Benefits
programs.blurb: Recently separated resident war-period veterans get a one-time free hunting or fishing license (within 365 days of discharge), and resident veterans rated 50% or more can get a Disabled Veteran Recreation Card covering annual fishing, small game hunting, and state park and trail admission.

programs.name: Veterans Housing and Recovery Program
programs.blurb: Provides homeless and at-risk veterans with temporary housing plus job training, education, and counseling support to help them obtain permanent housing; the program now operates at Union Grove only.

states.notes: WDVA also offers the Vet Ed Reimbursement Grant for part-time study (https://dva.wi.gov/benefits/education/vet-ed-reimbursement-grant/; not re-verified this pass). WDVA announced closure of the Chippewa Falls and Green Bay VHRP sites by September 30 (https://dva.wi.gov/press/two-veteran-housing-and-recovery-program-sites-to-close/); Union Grove remains open.

states.name: Wyoming

programs.name: Veterans Property Tax Exemption
programs.blurb: Honorably discharged wartime or overseas campaign/expeditionary-medal veterans (and certain disabled veterans and unremarried surviving spouses) with three or more years of Wyoming residency receive an annual exemption that lowers the assessed value of their primary residence, or can apply it to vehicle registration fees instead.

programs.name: Overseas Combat Veteran (OCV) Tuition Benefit (W.S. 19-14-106)
programs.blurb: Wyoming Statute 19-14-106 provides free tuition for up to eight semesters at the University of Wyoming and Wyoming community colleges for eligible overseas combat veterans and their surviving spouses and dependents.

programs.name: Veterans' Interview Preference in Public Employment (W.S. 19-14-102)
programs.blurb: Honorably discharged veterans with at least one year of Wyoming residency, and qualifying surviving spouses, get a preference before the interview stage for initial public employment, including a 5% scoring advantage (10% with a service-connected disability of 10% or more) where a numerical scoring system is used.

programs.name: Veterans' Home of Wyoming
programs.blurb: The 117-bed Veterans' Home of Wyoming in Buffalo, operated by the Wyoming Department of Health, offers connected assisted-living and skilled nursing communities for honorably discharged veterans and eligible dependents.

programs.name: Free Game and Fish Licenses for Disabled Veterans and Purple Heart Recipients
programs.blurb: Wyoming Game & Fish issues free licenses to resident veterans: a lifetime fishing license at 50% or higher service-connected disability, a bird, fish, and small game license at 100% disability, and the same bird, fish, and small game license to Purple Heart recipients.

states.notes: Wyoming has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed by default. The Wyoming Veterans Commission also operates the Oregon Trail State Veterans Cemetery in Evansville. Property tax exemption requires three or more years of Wyoming residency; exemption dollar amount omitted as it has been subject to recent legislative change.
